analysis.session_summary: The session was dominated by the FOMC: rates printed 4.00% against a 4.00% forecast but the dollar still strengthened, leaving USD +0.516% against majors and DXY +0.553%. GBP was the weakest major at -0.308% after an inline 3-0-6 BoE vote failed to support it, while risk assets firmed (SPX +0.355%, VIX -2.297%) and oil fell (Brent -1.226%). Major USD pairs closed near session extremes: EUR/USD -58.5 pips, GBP/USD -96.3 pips, USD/JPY +94.3 pips. The tape points to hawkish FOMC re-pricing and stretched GBP longs into the BoE.

themes.evidence: Federal Funds Rate printed 4.00% vs forecast 4.00%, yet USD gained 0.516% vs majors, DXY +0.553% and USD/CHF +0.704%; Warsh stressed inflation was 'too high for too long'.
GBP was weakest at -0.308%; GBP/USD -96.3 pips and EUR/GBP +18.2 pips; MPC votes 3-0-6 printed inline but GBP weakened 0.289% in event reaction.

themes.theme: Risk-on tone with commodity FX lagging
themes.evidence: SPX +0.355%, VIX -2.297%, but Brent -1.226%; AUD/USD -17.7 pips, NZD/USD -28.3 pips; USD/SEK +497.2 and USD/NOK +714.1.
USD/JPY +94.3 pips but CHF/JPY -12.0 pips; USD/JPY had a 105.1-pip no-catalyst down leg before the Philly Fed up leg.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: A 73.3-pip FOMC-led decline was followed by an 18.3-pip no-catalyst bounce, leaving the pair net -58.5 pips.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: Down 69.4 pips on FOMC, up 33.5 pips without a clear catalyst, then down 55.4 pips on the BoE vote to close -96.3 pips.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: Up 126.0 pips into the FOMC spillover, down 105.1 pips without a clear catalyst, then up 72.0 pips on Philly Fed to net +94.3 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: An FOMC-driven 70.8-pip rally was only partly offset by a 13.1-pip no-catalyst pullback, net +57.7 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: FOMC lifted it 57.2 pips, then a 25.0-pip no-catalyst pullback and a 11.3-pip drift left net +45.7 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: An FOMC-spillover 49.9-pip drop was followed by a 33.6-pip no-catalyst bounce, net -17.7 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: An FOMC-spillover 49.2-pip drop, a 43.7-pip rebound, then a 20.3-pip Philly-Fed drop left net -28.3 pips.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: Multiple small swings net +18.3 pips, with no leg clearly owned by a single catalyst.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: Four legs netted -12.0 pips; no single trigger owned the tape.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: Seven legs net +29.8 pips, with the NZ GDP-driven 19.9-pip down move the only medium-confidence leg.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: A 19.0-pip drop and then a 36.4-pip rise tied to the UK bank rate decision net +18.2 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: Close +26.4 pips with no catalyst clearly owning the move.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: Multiple small legs net +9.9 pips; no single trigger dominated.
leg_notes.USD/SEK: A huge 1089.9-pip FOMC rally was only partly retraced by a 794.8-pip no-catalyst decline, net +497.2 pips.
leg_notes.USD/NOK: An 800.5-pip FOMC-driven rally and a 112.6-pip no-catalyst pullback still left USD/NOK +714.1 pips on the day.
leg_notes.USD/ZAR: A 1293.2-pip up leg, a 1961.9-pip down leg, and a 605.4-pip Philly-Fed up leg left the pair nearly flat at -16.8 pips.
leg_notes.USD/MXN: An FOMC-spillover 1266.5-pip rally was partly retraced by a 824.7-pip no-catalyst drop; close was +498.1 pips.
leg_notes.Brent/USD: A no-catalyst 129.8-pip drop, a 137.5-pip bounce, a 437.0-pip decline, then a 296.5-pip rebound net -131.8 pips.
